{{Top|leg}}
The '''Grand Moot''' was an annual event on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yelsain/Legends|Yelsain]], located in a huge open field a few hundred [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] north of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tradetown]]. [[Merchant/Legends|Merchants]] from all over the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] were invited to land and trade their goods with the locals. A [[Standard week/Legends|week]] long event, it was known for much drinking, [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]], general carousing, trading, [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]], fighting and many more recreational activities.<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref>
